top_category:
(defn top_category [& args]
  (let [spent (by_category)]
    (if (empty? spent)
      nil
      (first (sort-by (fn [c] [(- (to_cents (get spent c))) c]) (keys spent))))))
over_budget:
(defn over_budget []
  (let [spent (by_category)
        budgets (get (state) "budgets")
        over (reduce-kv (fn [acc c b] (if (budget_over (get spent c 0) b) (conj acc c) acc)) [] budgets)]
    (vec (sort over))))
set_budget:
(defn set_budget [category amount]
  (when-not (and (number? amount) (not (neg? amount))) (throw (ex-info "budget must not be negative" {})))
  (swap-state! assoc-in ["budgets" category] amount)
  amount)
add_expense_entry:
(defn add_expense_entry [amount category with_note note]
  (when-not (and (number? amount) (pos? amount)) (throw (ex-info "amount must be positive" {})))
  (when-not (and (string? category) (pos? (count category))) (throw (ex-info "category is required" {})))
  (when (and with_note (not (string? note))) (throw (ex-info "breaks expenses-shape" {})))
  (let [e (if with_note
            {"amount" amount "category" category "note" note}
            {"amount" amount "category" category})]
    (swap-state! update "expenses" (fnil conj []) e)
    (count (get (state) "expenses"))))
by_category:
(defn by_category []
  (let [sums (reduce (fn [acc e] (update acc (get e "category") (fnil + 0) (get e "amount"))) {} (get (state) "expenses"))
        cent-map (reduce-kv (fn [acc c v] (assoc acc c (to_cents v))) {} sums)
        parts (reduce + 0 (vals cent-map))
        target (to_cents (reduce + 0 (vals sums)))
        fixed (if (and (seq cent-map) (not (== parts target)))
                (let [biggest (first (sort-by (fn [c] [(- (get cent-map c)) c]) (keys cent-map)))]
                  (assoc cent-map biggest (+ (get cent-map biggest) (- target parts))))
                cent-map)]
    (reduce-kv (fn [acc c v] (assoc acc c (cents_to_amount v))) {} fixed)))
add_expense:
(defn add_expense
  ([amount category] (add_expense_entry amount category false nil))
  ([amount category note] (add_expense_entry amount category true note)))
